elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Contractor must provide transition assistance to Company.
elements.evidence: Section 6(c) applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason” and requires Contractor, at Company’s request, to provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six (6) months.
elements.evidence: Section 6(c)(i) expressly provides transition assistance “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Contractor’s then-current rates.
Contractor must return all Company data to Company.
elements.evidence: Section 6(c)(ii) requires Contractor to “return to Company all Company data in Contractor’s possession or control.”

elements.element: Contractor must return the Company data within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 6(c)(ii) requires return “within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination.”

elements.element: The returned Company data must be in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Section 6(c)(ii) expressly requires “a standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: Contractor must delete the returned Company data from its systems thereafter.
elements.evidence: Section 6(c)(iii) requires Contractor to “thereafter delete all such data from its systems.”

elements.element: Contractor must certify deletion of the Company data to Company thereafter.
elements.evidence: Section 6(c)(iii) requires Contractor to “certify such deletion to Company in writing.”

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Contractor must provide transition assistance to Company.
elements.evidence: Section 6(c) applies upon expiry or termination for any reason and requires transition assistance at Company’s request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least ninety (90) days.
elements.evidence: The clause provides assistance for up to six months, which exceeds the fallback 90-day assistance period.

elements.element: Contractor must export Company data within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 6(c)(ii) requires all Company data to be returned in a standard machine-readable format within thirty days, satisfying the export requirement.

result.reason: The added operative provision fully implements the preferred position and therefore also satisfies the fallback. It covers both expiry and termination, six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable data return within 30 days, deletion, and written deletion certification. The additions are confined to the transition and data-return mechanics and do not alter the existing termination, payment, or work-in-progress provisions.
